wholePhysicalScope: Official monument polygon 894 locates the roadside strip containing the stone. The memorial itself is centered along the documented boundary.
lodDetails: All detail levels retain the historically documented exterior and setting. Near levels refine coping, supported projections, openings and stone details.
limitations: The official map fixes the memorial setting. Stone, base and cap dimensions and their position within the heritage area are estimates.
The closeup models use selected names, date and the reservoir title from the documented inscription. The carved surface represents the historical lettering at medium fidelity.
